source.purpose: Final Semester 2 review for Ch8 (Weeks 11-13). Ch8 IND avg 92.2% — auto-graded items all scored ≥95%, but the three FRQs were big misses (slope inference concept 65%, correlation interpretation 77%, explanatory vs response 77% on group). Reuse-heavy slate that supplements the existing ch8-regression-practice (which was course-copied to cid 301265 as aid 22462700) by drilling the FRQ-style interpretation gaps with auto-graded versions plus reusing the three target FRQ files directly.

hw_scrape_findings: HW 8.2 q6 (51%, 34.8% incomplete) is an extreme outlier — every other Ch8 HW item is ≥91%. Slot 13 draft isolates slope+intercept interpretation cleanly in a different context.

Ch8 IND auto-graded items all 95%+. The three FRQs (slope inference 65%, correlation interp 77%, explanatory/response 77%) explain almost the entire delta. Final review's job is to drill those three FRQ concepts in both auto-graded form (slots 7, 13, 18) and essay form (slots 20-22).
HW 8.4 full workflow (q8) has 27.1% incomplete despite scoring 96% among completers — engagement on the multi-step problem. Slot 19 (CI from tech output reuse) is a lighter integrative alternative.

Existing ch8-regression-practice.json (built 2026-04-26, course-copied to cid 301265 as aid 22462700) already covers chapter sections well; final-review supplements with the FRQ-style interpretation focus.
